title: Handoff command request
description: The durable record of the ONE opening Handoff for a Session's fixed (W, H] (continuity.md — Handoff and seed policy). It is stored as the command_dispatches.request of a `handoff` command whose request key is derived from the range, so a crash-then-retry finds this command instead of reserving a second one. Recovery reads these fields; it never re-derives the range from whatever the journal head happens to be later.

uri.description: The descriptive URI of the embedded resource content block. A resource LINK is not acceptable: it delivers no bytes.

policyRevision.description: The seed policy this rendering obeyed, e.g. handoff-seed-v1. A policy change gets a new revision id; it never silently re-seeds a live context.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the complete rendered resource — the digest a custody driver looks for as evidence of delivery.

degraded.description: True when the range did not fit and the policy's overflow path was taken; requires an explicit confirmation before dispatch.
